spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS recent_count
FROM public.player_stats;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.name LIKE 'Default Name%' THEN 'Unnamed (' || LEFT(s.id::text, 8) || ')'
    ELSE s.name
  END AS server,
  COUNT(*) AS active_players
FROM public.player_stats ps
JOIN public.servers s ON s.id = ps.server_id
WHERE ps.last_seen >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  AND s.last_seen >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
ORDER BY active_players DESC
LIMIT 5;
